title: #MYProjectisUSA 2016

meta.description: MY First Youth Community Leadership Conference to Empower Muslim American Youth.
meta.ogDescription: MY First Youth Community Leadership Conference to Empower Muslim American Youth.

items.html:
CONFERENCE: 

#MYProjectisUSA 2016
Saturday & Sunday, January 16 & 17, 2016.

9 a.m. - 6 p.m. 

 

Preferred Participants: Age 13 - 25

 

TICKETS: $35.00
Each youth (Age 13-25) will have a chance to win exclusive prizes after attending all sessions. 
SEATS ARE LIMITED

 

SCHOLARSHIPS: 
Can't pay? Ask for scholarship.
Limited number of need-based scholarship are available on first come first serve basis. Please email to info@myprojectusa.org for more information.

 

LOCATION:
Franklin Hall
Columbus State Community College
550 E Spring St., Columbus, OH 43215

 

TOPICS COVERED:
Combating Extremist Violence, Civic Engagement, Public Service, Political Mobilization of the Community, Black Lives Matter, Immigration Reform, The Art of Story Telling, Creating a Digital Footprint, Environmental Issues, Taking Care of Refugees, Building a Compassionate Community, Stopping Drugs, Gangs, Bullies & Human Trafficking.

 

COLLABORATORS:
Muslims for Ohio PAC (MOPAC)
CAIR-OH
MSA-OSU

 

SPONSORS:
Helping Hand
EMERGE USA
Islamic Society of Greater Columbus (ISGC)
